metadata.note: San Antonio and Aransas Pass Railway ('Sap', 'the Aransas Pass'), chartered 1884, first train 1886, and its lines under Southern Pacific after the 1925 lease to the GH&SA (T&NO lease 1927, merger into T&NO 1934, SP 1961 - not splits, all shown as Southern Pacific). Features are split by drawable span x operator (Rule 4): San Antonio and Aransas Pass features end 1924; Southern Pacific features on identical geometry start no earlier than the first CONFIRMED SP-era year (1926/1927/1940/1942 by line), so 1925-1926 and most of 1925-1941 are deliberately undrawn gaps, not ends. The 1890/1892 SP stock control and the 1903 divestiture are NOT splits - the SA&AP ran its own trains until 1925. The Falfurrias - McAllen and Edinburg - Brownsville Valley lines (1927) were run by SP from opening and carry no SA&AP feature. Research report: research/branches/san_antonio_and_aransas_pass_railway.txt.

not_yet_sourced: [OPEN] ends (last CONFIRMED year, not a known end): Rockport Branch 1923; Lockhart Branch (Shiner - Luling, Luling - Lockhart) 1920; SP San Antonio - Beeville 1942 (gone by Sept 1951); SP Beeville - Corpus Christi 1951 (1952 per CRF-CRP/TTM-CC); SP San Antonio - Kerrville 1942 (ended by 1947 per TTM-KV); SP Yoakum - Giddings 1942 (1949 per CRF-WCO, single-source); SP Skidmore - McAllen 1951; SP Edinburg - Brownsville 1942 (gone by Sept 1951).
[ANCHOR] single years: SP Kenedy - Houston 1942; SP Giddings - Waco 1942.
SP-era 1925-1941 almost unevidenced on every line (no post-1923 BL-TX1 letter; OG52 is 1951; CRF gives 1942). A 1930s SP timetable or Texas Railroad Commission annual report would fill it.
1925 split date: TSHA-GHSA 1 Jan 1925 vs another account 1 May 1925; lessee named GH&SA (TSHA) or T&NO (TTM-SAAP). The year is agreed.
San Antonio - Kenedy end: TTM-CC 'last train 1952' conflicts with OG52 Table 55 (Sept 1951 freight only, bus substitution); primary source governs.
Alice - Falfurrias opening 1904 (TSHA) vs 1903 (TTM-SAAP); Kerrville first train 6 Oct 1887 (TTM-KV) vs Aug 1887 (WIKI-SAAP); Corpus Christi reached Nov 1886 vs 1887 (TTM-SAAP both).
Terminals: SA&AP's own San Antonio station closed c.1910 and its own Houston station before Grand Central (year not established) - see geometry_quality notes.
All headway_min and avg_speed_kmh values are estimates.
metadata.freight_only_audit: Born compliant 2026-11-23: every span ends at the last confirmed passenger year; OG52 (Sept-Dec 1951) freight-only tables 51, 54, 55, 57, 64, 65 used only to bound ends from above. Abandonment years (1933 Shiner - Luling, 1970/71 Camp Stanley - Kerrville, 1985 Gregory - Rockport) are not used as passenger ends.
